findings.message: The two new security controls (envelope encryption-at-rest; per-service-principal + TLS API↔store boundary) are introduced without an explicit in-scope vs out-of-scope threat statement. Envelope encryption-at-rest addresses store/disk compromise and snapshot exfiltration but not live-credential compromise or in-process plaintext; the trust-boundary control addresses credential theft / on-path tampering of the API↔store link but not a compromised service principal. The §2/§10 scoping carries most of C4's intent (abuse/open-redirect/cache deferred), so this is a residual altitude gap, not a hole.
findings.recommendation: Add a one-line threat framing to the §6 data-at-rest / trust-boundary notes: name what each control covers (store-compromise, on-path tampering, credential theft) and what it explicitly does not (live-principal compromise, in-process plaintext), so SPEC inherits the threat envelope, not just the control.

findings.message: The new fail-closed-on-auth/TLS-failure commitment (ADR.01.03.1050) and the encryption-at-rest commitment (ADR.01.03.0db1) have no verification criterion or monitoring signal. §8 covers RPO=0, uniqueness, write-path fail-closed, and count isolation, but no success criterion confirms (a) an auth/TLS failure to the store fails the write closed, nor (b) at-rest encryption is enabled on the provisioned KV tier. The controls are asserted but not evidenced.
findings.recommendation: Add a §8 success criterion that an injected store-auth/TLS failure yields no acknowledged code and no orphan mapping (reuses BDD.01.03.f44a/ed21/5f58 fixtures), and a §7 provisioning/launch check that at-rest envelope encryption is confirmed enabled on the KV tier before go-live.

notes: Iteration-2 re-audit: prior blocking C1 (API↔store trust boundary) and C3 (data-at-rest crypto) both verified RESOLVED as written — ADR.01.03.1050 names per-service principal + least-privilege scope + TLS 1.2+ + fail-closed (C1/C2/C5), ADR.01.03.0db1 names AES-256 envelope + provider KMS + rotation cadence (C3). SE1 not fired (storage-owned high-sev risks mitigated in-decision and gated in §8). Two P3 residuals (threat-framing C4, audit-evidence). Verdict: Pass.
